# workers

## Classes

### OysterMcpOwner

One tenant's live SDK transports; cold owners refuse old IDs without execution
replay. The persisted origin is a lifetime pin. Changing the configured origin
requires a fresh MCP namespace; an existing owner never retargets its retained
pin.

- `DurableObject`\<`Env`\>

##### alarm()

```ts
alarm(): Promise<void>;
```

One Registry wake serves both owners: installation work, then the native
approval home. Each re-arms only an earlier wake, so neither postpones the
other, and one owner's failure never skips the other's quantum.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

###### Overrides

```ts
DurableObject.alarm;
```

```ts
  Awaited<ReturnType<GitBinding[keyof GitBinding]>> | Schema.Json | undefined;
```

Native values returned by the standalone Git, event and JSON binding owners.

```ts
type OysterBindingContext<Env> = Readonly<{

        submit: Promise<
           | {
           kind: ...;

           description: ...;
         }

     workflows?: (principal) => Promise<

        status: Promise<...>;

      }
       | null>;

     auth: OysterAuth;
     backgroundOriginKey?: () => Promise<CryptoKey>;
     artifacts: ArtifactStore;
     uiCache?: VerifiedObjectCache;
     installations: InstallationStore;
     instances: InstanceDirectory;
     bootUi: (release) => Promise<UiBootCheckOutcome>;
     computerId?: string;
     computer?: (principal) => KnapsackComputer | null | Promise<KnapsackComputer | null>;
     appToolPolicy?: (actor) =>
        | AppToolPolicy
        | null
       | Promise<AppToolPolicy | null>;
     keys?: Readonly<{
        live: Promise<Readonly<...> | null>;
     }>;
     guestLimits?: Partial<GuestLimits>;
     mcp?: OysterMcp;
     git?: OysterGitHost;
     ownerRoutes?: Hono<OysterEnv>;
     capabilities?: readonly OysterCapability[];
     workbench?: Readonly<{
        directory: Promise<Readonly<{
           apps: ...;
           roles: ...;
           computer?: ...;
        }>>;
        storage: Pick<AppStorageWire, ... | ... | ...> & Readonly<{
           events: ...;
        }>;
     }>;
     homeInstallationId?: string;
     pageScript?: string;
     pageAssets?: () => Promise<{
        pageScript: string;
        publicHomeScript: string;
        fontStyles: string;
        loginFontStyles: string;
        shellStyles: string;
        grantConsentScript: string;
     }>;
     title?: string;
   }>
    | null>;
}>;
```

### OysterBindingRow

```ts
type OysterBindingRow<Env> = Readonly<{
  methods: Readonly<Record<string, FrameBindingMethod<OysterBindingResult>>>;
  dispatch: Promise<OysterBindingResult>;

}>;
```

### oysterBindingEntrypoint()

```ts
function oysterBindingEntrypoint<Env>(table): typeof WorkerEntrypoint;
```

The one guest binding entrypoint over `table`. Every binding in a frame is this
export with its own props; each packet returns to its originating Instance,
which serves it from the same table.

#### Type Parameters
